description: How the benchmark reads each prepared dataset (data/processed/<dataset>/records.parquet). Every text field is normalised once by make data (accents, case, punctuation and spacing; see dataset.normalise_text), except digits_fields, which keep only their digits; methods read the normalised records. text_fields are joined, in order and skipping nulls, into one text per record for TF-IDF blocking. Cora's fields are often misassigned by its parser, so all of them are used. Field lists for the field-by-field methods are added with those methods.
